text.tspan: aurora_cli — Command-line interface that discovers Aurora model homes,
validates mission-scoped models, renders Markdown + SVG views, and
aurora_shared — Shared domain library that implements model discovery,
parsing, validation, rendering, and compact export helpers for Aurora
CLI Command Runner — CLI entrypoint and command dispatcher (clap
subcommands) that orchestrates discovery, validation, rendering, and
compact export workflows and reports diagnostics and summaries.
Model Discovery and Loading — Discovery and parsing layer that
locates model homes (schema-based), loads card files (JSON/JSJSON)
from disk, and builds a searchable AuroraModel index.
Validation Engine — Validator that checks structural invariants
(duplicate ids, mission presence, link targets, reachability) plus
policy checks (secret asset ownership) and relationship-matrix
Rendering Engine — Renderer that produces per-card Markdown
documentation, executive summaries, canonical view DOT sources, and
themed SVG diagrams; also writes compact agent exports.
Embedded Registries — Compile-time canonical registries for card
view definitions (canonical view set) used by validation and
Repository File System — Filesystem-backed store that holds Aurora
